provider_receipt.summary: Independent review found the governed read-only context-recovery node supported. The execution receipt contains successful read evidence for every declared context source plus repository instructions and Cargo workspace context; the tool-output digests correctly authenticate read-call envelopes and need not equal source-content digests. No context_use_receipt was required because none was supplied by the capsule. The verification receipt is parent-bound to execution and covers the declared test check: cargo test -p arda-core passed with exit code 0. Empty execution artifacts and absence of mutating tool calls support read-only compliance. No defect invalidates this node. Recovered context does expose broader implementation defects for downstream work: the production project registry still mixes proof/demo contracts with the two reviewed projects, and the canonical queue/projection contains extensive duplicate pending execute/verify materialization rather than one canonical next action.
